description: Approve a short list of read-only agami sm calls and agami's own scratch files under <artifacts_dir>/local/tmp. Says nothing about anything else.

hooks.command: in=$(cat); for p in python3 python; do [ "$("$p" -I -c 'print(end="agami-ok")' </dev/null 2>/dev/null)" = agami-ok ] && out=$(printf '%s' "$in" | "$p" -I "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/approve_own_calls.py" 2>/dev/null) && { printf '%s' "$out"; break; }; done; true
